title: Amalfi Coast · An Italian Summer
description: Collector Edition art pilot: an original Mediterranean terrace view of a fictional Positano-inspired coastal village, individually placed villas, loggia, majolica church dome, bougainvillea, lemons, terracotta planter, sailboats and a vintage scooter. Directional tonal gradients and local material marks, with a slow camera descent toward the waterfront. Original stylised illustration, not a reconstruction of a specific location.
author: OpenMotion Studio
